# cb:b302 · dag-immutability

> Assertions are immutable once created - existing fields are never edited; the only mutations are status transitions (active -> superseded/retracted/retired) and append-only evidence entries

**Type:** attestation · **Kind:** schema · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `status-lifecycle`
**Created:** 2026-04-12

## Evidence

1. **2026-04-12** - Editing assertions in place would erase the history the DAG exists to preserve. Immutability forces supersession chains, which makes state drift visible as stale deps on compounds.
